line.name: E.P. Carrillo Encore TAA Exclusive (Encore TAA 656)
line.background_text: Released 2020 exclusively for Tobacconists Association of America (TAA) retailers, the Encore TAA 656 is an all-Nicaraguan-tobacco expression of Encore, a departure from the standard Encore's Ecuadorian-wrapper blend. Its extreme box press gives the 6x56 'Toro Gordo' vitola an oval-like cross-section. Announced March 2020, shipped August 2020, limited to 750 boxes of 10, produced at Tabacalera La Alianza S.A.

research_notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: E.P. Carrillo releases a new TAA exclusive nearly every year; this 2020 'Encore TAA 656' is the one explicitly Encore-branded. A separate 2022 TAA Exclusive release exists but is NOT part of the Encore line (Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, different blend/vitola) - do not conflate the two.
